name: Instrumentl
summary: A grant prospecting and management platform for nonprofits and grant consultants.

facts.label: Primary use
facts.value: Finding, tracking, and managing grant opportunities in one workflow.

facts.label: Audience
facts.value: Nonprofits and grant consultants.

facts.label: Trial
facts.value: The vendor advertises a 14-day free trial with no credit card required.

name: Grants.gov
summary: The official U.S. federal portal for organizations seeking federal grant opportunities.

facts.label: Primary use
facts.value: Finding and applying for federal grant opportunities.

facts.label: Grant lifecycle
facts.value: The portal describes pre-award, award, and post-award phases.

facts.label: Scope
facts.value: Federal grant programs; eligibility varies by opportunity.

name: GrantStation
summary: A funder research database and learning platform for nonprofit grantseekers.

facts.label: Primary use
facts.value: Researching funders and building a grant strategy.

facts.label: Database claim
facts.value: The vendor says its U.S. Charitable database includes more than 15,000 researched profiles.

facts.label: Learning support
facts.value: The vendor offers training on grantseeking strategy and proposal development.

name: GrantHub
summary: Grant management software designed for grantseekers, including nonprofits and grant consultants.

facts.label: Primary use
facts.value: Managing proposals, funders, tasks, and deadlines.

facts.label: Audience
facts.value: Nonprofit organizations, grant consultants, and other fundraising professionals.

facts.label: Ownership disclosure
facts.value: GrantHub identifies itself as being powered by Foundant Technologies.

name: Candid search
summary: A funder and nonprofit research platform combining Candid's Foundation Directory and GuideStar data.

facts.label: Primary use
facts.value: Researching funders, grant history, and nonprofit organizations.

facts.label: Vendor-reported coverage
facts.value: Candid reports 304,000+ funder profiles and 29 million+ grants.

facts.label: Standard starting price
facts.value: Candid lists Premium at $219 per month billed monthly or $2,199 billed annually; these are vendor-listed standard starting prices.

facts.label: Free access option
facts.value: Candid says partner locations offer free access to Candid and nonprofit fundraising resources.

name: Fluxx Grantseeker
summary: Grant tracking software for organizations managing multiple active grants across teams.

facts.label: Primary use
facts.value: Centralizing active-grant deadlines, budgets, reporting requirements, documents, and team responsibilities.

facts.label: Audience
facts.value: The vendor positions Grantseeker for nonprofits, higher education institutions, and public-sector organizations managing 10–50 or more active grants.

facts.label: Vendor-listed starting price
facts.value: Fluxx lists Grantseeker as starting at $6,000 per year and says pricing scales with annual grant volume.

facts.label: Vendor-reported implementation time
facts.value: Fluxx says most organizations can implement Grantseeker in approximately one to two weeks.

name: OpenGrants
summary: A grant prospecting and application-workflow platform for finding opportunities and managing a funding pipeline.

facts.label: Primary use
facts.value: Searching open grant opportunities, checking potential eligibility fit, and tracking selected opportunities through an application pipeline.

facts.label: Application workflow
facts.value: The vendor says users can save opportunities, assign owners, track stages and deadlines, and keep team notes on each opportunity.

facts.label: Vendor-listed Pro price
facts.value: OpenGrants lists Pro at $9 per month or $8 per month billed annually, following a 7-day free trial.

facts.label: Pro plan operations features
facts.value: The vendor lists team collaboration for up to five users, portfolio analytics, and compliance tracking among the Pro plan features.

name: Grantable
summary: An AI-assisted platform for grant prospecting, proposal development, team workflow, and pipeline management.

facts.label: Primary use
facts.value: Finding potential funders, developing grant proposals, and managing grant work in one workspace.

facts.label: Prospecting method
facts.value: The vendor says its prospect-matching system uses a database built from 990 filings, public records, and targeted web research, and provides a rationale for each match.

facts.label: Application workflow
facts.value: The vendor lists RFP checklist extraction, source-informed drafting, a reusable content library, and inline writing suggestions.

facts.label: Team operations
facts.value: The vendor lists section assignments, roles and permissions, anchored review comments, information requests, deadlines, status tracking, and calendar views.

facts.label: Vendor-listed monthly prices
facts.value: Grantable lists a Free plan, Starter at $50 per month, and Pro at $150 per month; usage capacity varies by plan.

facts.label: Vendor-listed nonprofit discount
facts.value: Grantable advertises 50% off Starter and Pro for one year for qualifying 501(c)(3) organizations with annual operating budgets under $500,000, subject to verification.

name: Grant Holster
summary: Grant-operations software for organizations and consultants coordinating grant deadlines, records, documents, and collaborators.

facts.label: Primary use
facts.value: Keeping grant deadlines, collaborators, client and funder records, documents, and reports in one workflow.

facts.label: Consultant operations
facts.value: The vendor positions its client-based architecture for grant consultants and leaders managing work across clients or departments.

facts.label: Vendor-listed monthly prices
facts.value: Grant Holster lists Bronze at $29 per month, Silver at $69 per month, and Gold at $109 per month; plan limits and user allowances vary.

facts.label: Vendor-listed trial
facts.value: The vendor advertises a 30-day free trial for its Bronze, Silver, and Gold plans.

facts.label: Vendor-listed plan capacity
facts.value: Bronze includes one administrator, unlimited viewers, and limits of 25 projects and 25 funders; Gold includes one administrator, five editors, unlimited viewers, projects, funders, clients, contacts, and actions.

name: Submittable
summary: Full-lifecycle grant management software for organizations running application, review, award, and reporting programs.

facts.label: Primary use
facts.value: Launching grant programs, collecting applications, coordinating reviews, tracking funds, and reporting across the grant lifecycle.

facts.label: Audience
facts.value: The vendor positions the platform for grantmakers across public and private sectors, including nonprofits, government grantmakers, foundations, and businesses running community-investment programs.

facts.label: Workflow features
facts.value: The vendor lists a drag-and-drop form builder, custom review workflows, real-time collaboration, financial tracking, and reporting with integrated analytics.

facts.label: Pricing process
facts.value: Submittable does not display dollar amounts on its pricing page; it directs buyers to book a meeting to select features and capacity for their organization.

facts.label: Vendor-stated security controls
facts.value: Submittable says it completes an annual third-party SOC 2 Type 2 audit and supports SAML single sign-on and multiple permission levels.
